note: Visual-composition outcome corpus for the large-text accessibility surface (FIX-DS-06.05, finding DS-06/XD-13; fifth sibling, after 06.01–06.04; the family's accessibility lane has NO owner, so this corpus judges only what sheleg-design owns — composition under large text — and never claims a WCAG audit). The same two judged layers stay SEPARATE: routing/constraint/provenance correctness is judged deterministically on artifacts here; the VISUAL outcome is judged by an independent render rubric against the actual render at the same viewport and content — that live model/render eval is a SEPARATE authorized execution batch after implementation, which no fixture task imitates. A correct render is NOT obliged to change; a mechanical PASS never substitutes for composition judgement; a fault names a region and what is wrong, never only a token/style name; a claimed screenshot must EXIST as a decodable file (a mention is not a file); an offline/no-keys route reports NOT_RUN and proposes no install; 100% structural PASS is never phrased as a proven design improvement — comparison stays UNMEASURED until the authorized run (identical inputs/budget/viewports, blind order, repeated samples, failures/cost/time recorded).

prompt.text: Review an already-correct screen at 200% text zoom (no clipped labels, rhythm held). Identity-preserving: a correct render is NOT obliged to change — record kept/changed per region with a reason into largetext-review.md; zero changes with reasons is a valid outcome.

Stress the dashboard fixture at 200% browser zoom and 1.5x platform font scale at viewport 1280x800 with the SAME content fixture both arms use: a stat row, a button row and a dense table. Write zoom-stress.md naming the faults on the actual render — a fault names a region and what is wrong (clipped, overlapped, pushed off-viewport), never only a token/style name.

Judge whether the visual hierarchy survives large text on the actual render: the one-anchor rule per viewport, and whether size-based hierarchy collapses when all sizes grow — the composition question no token check answers. Write hierarchy-review.md; a mechanical token PASS does not close this review.

Review the large-text surface WITHOUT any screenshot or render available: every claim that needs the render is marked NOT_RUN (what it would take), and no screenshot path is cited as existing. Write render-review.md.

State what this review DOES NOT cover: the family has no accessibility owner, so composition-under-large-text is judged here and a WCAG audit is NOT claimed — name the unowned lane and what a full audit would additionally need. Write scope-note.md.
